mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the risk-free rate and discount rates for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 105 AND HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) values are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240.0, it signals high inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and residential sales (RSAFS) below 450000 signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1200 AND RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 105, it signals a supply chain disruption that reduces corporate output and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
